_comment: Picked by Claude 2026-09-23 to match Agent One's actual mandate (agent_mandates/Agent_One_Mandate_v3.md): short-term high-velocity analyst, sector-agnostic, explicit small/micro-cap capitalization bias ('under-covered names may be an edge'), excludes ADRs/OTC/foreign listings/ETFs/SPACs/pre-revenue biotech. Deliberately NOT mega-cap blue chips -- those are low-velocity, well-covered, and the opposite of what this mandate looks for. Spread across sectors since the mandate is sector-agnostic; REITs/banks/insurers included since the mandate has explicit special-sector substitution rules for them, not an exclusion. Built from public knowledge, not live-verified against the deterministic eligibility screen -- any misclassified/ineligible name simply fails the real screen and returns NO_TRADE, which is safe. Sam + partner may still replace any of these; this is a defensible starting list, not a locked-in decision.
